department: Department of Geography, Planning and Environment

deadline.value: Fall entry only: January 15 for international applicants (February 1 for Canadian residents); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: February 1 (Canadian resident) | January 15 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

supervisor.value: You must secure a supervisor before applying; admission depends on a faculty member being available to supervise.
supervisor.quote: You are required to secure a supervisor when applying. | An admission offer will not be issued until a supervisor match has been made.

also.quote: Admission is contingent on the availability of an appropriate faculty member in the Department to serve as supervisor.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: An MA or MSc in geography, urban planning, environmental science or a related field is required.
entry_route.quote: MA or MSc in Geography, Urban Planning, Environmental Science, or a related field of study from a recognized university.

toefl_min.value: This program asks for TOEFL iBT 95 with no part under 20 (5.0, no part below 4.5, on the new scale).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum score of 95 with no component under 20 | Geography, Urban and Environmental Studies (PhD, MEnv, MSc, Diploma)

ielts_min.value: This program asks for IELTS 7.0 with no band under 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: 7.0 score with no component under 6.5 | Geography, Urban and Environmental Studies (PhD, MEnv, MSc, Diploma)
